info.name: Ecommerce API
info.description:
Ecommerce backend API. Import this one file; no separate environment is needed.

**Before you start:** run the backend (`npm run dev`). For the admin folder, create the first admin with `npm run create-admin`, then set `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` on the collection's Variables tab.

**Automatic:** login and signup requests save `accessToken`, and the refresh token is kept by Postman's cookie jar. Seller profile requests save `sellerProfileId`, and creating catalog items saves their ids.

**By hand:** OTP codes print in the server terminal while `EMAIL_DRIVER` and `SMS_DRIVER` are `console`. Copy each into the `otpCode` variable before sending the request that needs it.

**Errors** look like `{ "message": "...", "code": "...", "details": [...] }`. `code` and `details` are not always present.

**Rate limits** (per IP, all /auth routes): 300 requests per 15 min, 30 failed login or code attempts per 15 min, 20 signups per hour, 20 OTP sends per hour. Over the limit returns 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`. Restarting the server resets them.

request.description: 200 when Postgres is reachable, 503 otherwise.

item.name: Email and Password
item.description: Signup, login and session management. Sends a verification code on signup.

request.description: Creates a customer or seller and logs in. `termsAccepted` must be true and `role` can't be admin. Emails a verification code. 409 if the email is taken.
401 `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` if wrong. Five failures lock the account for 15 minutes (429 `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`).
Returns the logged-in user, including `emailVerified` and `phoneVerified`.
Uses the refresh cookie to get a new access token. The cookie rotates and the old one stops working.
Ends this session. Returns 204.
Ends every session. Returns 204. An access token already issued keeps working until it expires (15 minutes).

item.name: Email OTP
item.description: Verifying an email and logging in with an emailed code.

request.description: Sends a code only if the account exists and its email is unverified. Always returns the same 200, even if no code was sent, so the response can't reveal which accounts exist. One send per 60 seconds for each target and purpose, 5 per hour. The code prints in the server terminal until real providers are set up: copy it into the otpCode variable.
No login needed. 400 `INVALID_OTP` if the code is wrong, expired or used. A code allows 5 attempts.

Sends a code only to an existing account. Email OTP never creates accounts. Always returns the same 200, even if no code was sent, so the response can't reveal which accounts exist. One send per 60 seconds for each target and purpose, 5 per hour. The code prints in the server terminal until real providers are set up: copy it into the otpCode variable.
If the email was never verified, this verifies it, clears the password and ends existing sessions, so whoever registered the email without proving it loses access.

item.name: Password Reset
item.description: Setting a new password with an emailed code.

request.description: Sends a code only to an existing account. Always returns the same 200, even if no code was sent, so the response can't reveal which accounts exist. One send per 60 seconds for each target and purpose, 5 per hour. The code prints in the server terminal until real providers are set up: copy it into the otpCode variable.
Sets the new password and ends every session, so log in again afterwards. Change `newPassword` here to test a different one.

item.name: Phone OTP
item.description: Signing up or logging in by phone. Customers and sellers only; phone numbers use E.164 format.

request.description: Used for both signup and login. Admin numbers get no code. Always returns the same 200, even if no code was sent, so the response can't reveal which accounts exist. One send per 60 seconds for each target and purpose, 5 per hour. The code prints in the server terminal until real providers are set up: copy it into the otpCode variable.

item.name: Sign Up or Log In With Phone Code

request.description: New number: creates the account and returns 201 (`name` and `termsAccepted` are required, otherwise 400 `SIGNUP_DETAILS_REQUIRED` and the code stays usable). Existing number: logs in and returns 200, ignoring the signup fields.

item.name: Google
item.description: Google sign-in. Needs `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` in the backend's .env (503 `GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED` otherwise) and a real Google ID token in the `googleIdToken` variable.

item.name: Sign Up or Log In With Google

request.description: New user: creates a verified account and returns 201 (`termsAccepted: true` required, otherwise 400 `TERMS_REQUIRED`). Existing user: logs in and returns 200; `role` is ignored. Admins get 403.

item.name: Account Verification
item.description: For a logged-in user to add or verify a phone or email. Sellers need both verified before creating a store profile.

request.description: Sends a code to add this phone to the account. 409 if another account has it. 429 `OTP_COOLDOWN` within 60 seconds of the last code.
Adds the phone to the account as verified.
For an account's own unverified email, or to add one to a phone signup. 409 if the email belongs to another account, is already verified, or differs from the account's existing email.
Sets the email as verified on the account.

item.name: Seller
item.description: Create a store profile, which requires a seller account with both email and phone verified, then view or edit it.

request.description: Starts as `pending` until an admin reviews it. 403 `SELLER_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` lists what's unverified in `details`. 403 `FORBIDDEN` for non-sellers. 409 if the slug is taken or a profile exists. Only `storeName`, `storeSlug` and `legalBusinessName` are required.

body.raw:
{
  "storeName": "My Test Store",
  "storeSlug": "{{storeSlug}}",
  "description": "Test store",
  "supportEmail": "{{email}}",
  "supportPhone": "{{phone}}",
  "businessType": "individual",
  "legalBusinessName": "My Test Store Pvt Ltd",
  "taxId": "22AAAAA0000A1Z5"
}

request.description: Shows the seller's profile, `verificationStatus` and any `rejectionReason`. 404 `NOT_FOUND` until a profile is created.

Send only the fields to change; `null` clears an optional field. `taxId` is an optional GSTIN. Editing a rejected profile, or `legalBusinessName`, `businessType` or `taxId` on an approved one, returns it to `pending`. 409 `PROFILE_SUSPENDED` if suspended, 409 if the slug is taken.

item.name: Seller Products
item.description: A seller's products and variants. Needs a logged-in seller with a store profile, and a category with no sub-categories in `categoryId`. Other sellers' records return 404. Run in order: creating saves the ids that later requests use.

request.description: Creates a draft; variants are added separately. The category must be active with no sub-categories. `brandName` reuses a matching brand or creates one. Legal details can wait until publishing. Saves `productId`.

body.raw:
{
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "title": "Men's Cotton T-Shirt",
  "brandName": "{{brandName}}",
  "description": "Soft cotton t-shirt",
  "highlights": [
    "100% cotton",
    "Machine wash"
  ],
  "specifications": {
    "Material": "Cotton"
  },
  "hsnCode": "61091000",
  "genericName": "Men's T-Shirt",
  "countryOfOrigin": "IN",
  "manufacturerName": "Sample Mills Pvt Ltd",
  "manufacturerAddress": "12 Mill Road, Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu 641601",
  "isReturnable": true,
  "returnWindowDays": 7,
  "warrantySummary": "No warranty"
}

request.description: Newest first, any status. `status` is draft, active or paused. `limit` is at most 100.
One of my products, with its variants.

Send only the fields to change; `null` clears an optional field. `status` and the URL can't be set. Changing `categoryId` needs its variants to fit (409 `VARIANTS_DONT_FIT_CATEGORY`). A published product can't lose its legal details.

`options` must match the category; see Get Category Variant Options. Use an empty object if the category has none. Prices are in rupees and `sellingPrice` includes GST and can't exceed `mrp`. `gstRate` must be 0 with no GSTIN, and is required with one. Stock starts at 0. Saves `variantId`.
Send only the fields to change. Lower `sellingPrice` to give a discount. Stock can't be set here.

`change` is positive to add and negative to remove. `reason` is `initial` (only while a variant has no history), `restock` (adding) or `correction` (either way). 409 `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK` if it would go below 0. Sending the same request twice counts twice.
Every stock change for this variant, newest first.
Step 1 of an upload. `contentType` is image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp; `sizeBytes` is at most 5 MB. Saves `uploadUrl` and `storageKey`. 503 `STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED` until storage is set up.

Not a backend request: this sends the file straight to R2 or S3. Choose a PNG in the Body tab. The Content-Type must match what Get Upload URL was asked for. The URL expires after 5 minutes and uses no login.

Step 3 of an upload. Checks the stored file's real size, type and first bytes; a bad file is deleted (400 `INVALID_UPLOAD`). The first image becomes primary. `variantId` is optional. At most 8 per product. Saves `imageId`.
Send only the fields to change: `altText`, `sortOrder`, `variantId`, or `isPrimary: true`.
Deletes the image and its file. The next image becomes primary. 409 `LAST_IMAGE` if a published product would have none. Returns 204.

Puts a draft or paused product on sale. The store must be approved (403 `SELLER_NOT_APPROVED`) and the product not blocked (403 `PRODUCT_BLOCKED`). 400 `PRODUCT_NOT_READY` lists everything missing in `details`: legal details, an HSN code if the store has a GSTIN, an active variant with net quantity, weight and dimensions, and an image.
Takes a product off sale, keeping everything. Publish again to bring it back. 409 `INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE` for a draft.
Soft delete; frees its SKU and options. 409 `LAST_VARIANT` if a published product would have none. Returns 204.
Soft delete, along with its variants. Returns 204.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Uses `adminAccessToken`, so it doesn't disturb a seller or customer session in `accessToken`. Run Admin Log In first.

request.description: Logs in with `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` and saves `adminAccessToken`. Note the refresh cookie now belongs to the admin.
Creates another admin with a verified email. The first admin comes from `npm run create-admin`.
Oldest first, first 100. `status` is pending (default), approved, rejected or suspended. Saves the first result as `sellerProfileId`.
Works on pending or rejected profiles. 409 `INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE` if already approved.
`reason` is required. Works on pending or rejected profiles. 409 `INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE` if already approved.

item.name: Catalog
item.description: Public catalog data. No login needed. 300 requests per minute per IP.

request.description: Active categories as a tree. An inactive category hides everything below it.
Options and values a variant in this category can use, including those inherited from parents (`inherited: true`). 404 if the category or a parent is inactive.
Active brands by name. `q` finds names starting with it. `limit` is at most 100.

item.name: Admin Catalog
item.description: Manage categories, brands and variant options. Uses `adminAccessToken`, so run Admin Log In first. Names and slugs must be unique, so change them when re-running. Run in order: creating saves the ids that later requests use.

request.description: The slug is made from the name if not sent. Saves `categoryId`. 409 if the name or slug is taken.
At most 3 levels (400 `CATEGORY_TOO_DEEP`). 409 `CATEGORY_HAS_PRODUCTS` if the parent has products. Saves `subCategoryId`.
Every category as a flat list, including inactive ones.
Send only the fields to change; `null` clears an optional field. Change `parentId` to move it, or set `null` for the top level. `isActive: false` hides it and everything below it.
The kind of choice a variant can have, such as Size. The code is made from the name if not sent and can't change later. `allowCustomValues` lets sellers type their own value. Saves `optionId`.
Only `name` and `allowCustomValues` can change. Sending `code` returns 400.
All options with their values.
An allowed value such as Medium. The code is made from the label if not sent and can't change later. `colorHex` is an optional swatch. Saves `valueId`.
`label`, `colorHex` and `sortOrder` can change. Sending `code` returns 400.

Replaces the options set directly on this category; inherited ones aren't affected. Sub-categories inherit these, and can override them. 400 `INVALID_OPTION` if an option doesn't exist. Send an empty list to remove them all.
The slug is made from the name if not sent. Saves `brandId`. 409 if the name is taken.
Send only the fields to change. `isActive: false` hides it from the public list.
All brands, including inactive ones.

For a category image or brand logo. `purpose` is category or brand. Upload the file to the returned `uploadUrl`, then save `publicUrl` as the category's `imageUrl` or the brand's `logoUrl`. 503 `STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED` until storage is set up.
Soft delete. New variants can't use it; existing ones keep it. Returns 204.
Soft delete. 409 `BRAND_IN_USE` if products use it. Returns 204.
Soft delete. Returns 204.
Soft delete. 409 `CATEGORY_HAS_CHILDREN` or `CATEGORY_HAS_PRODUCTS` if it's in use; deactivate it instead. Returns 204.
Soft delete. 409 `OPTION_IN_USE` while a live category uses it. Returns 204.
